notes: Evaluates wide mechanical refactor skill: worktree check, fail-closed escalation to /cadence-spec (Deep-reasoning) when touching registered surfaces/schemas/semantics, Fast-mechanical (high effort) over exhaustive manifest, dual-search docs sweep, log triage, and offload_deep_review.

evals.name: escalates-public-surface-break-to-spec
evals.prompt: Use cadence-refactor to rename a CLI flag and remove a configuration key registered as Stable in cadence-surfaces.md.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to execute as a mechanical refactor because the target touches a Stable registered surface; escalates to /cadence-spec (Deep-reasoning, xhigh effort) for Surface Compatibility & deprecation compliance.
assertions: Consults docs/policies/surface-registry.md and docs/policies/cadence-surfaces.md before editing
Halts and escalates to /cadence-spec (Deep-reasoning, xhigh effort) when a registered surface or contract would change
Performs zero file mutations when escalating

evals.name: exhaustive-mechanical-sweep-and-post-checks
evals.prompt: Rename internal helper parseTimeoutMs -> parseDurationMs and swap its two arguments across src/ and tests/ inside our feature worktree.
evals.expected_output: Verifies dedicated worktree isolation and internal-only scope, builds complete manifest via local_semantic_embed + deterministic grep (plus docs/ dual search), confirms manifest with operator, executes cleanly under Fast-mechanical (high effort), verifies zero stale matches remain, runs canonical tests via offload_log_triage, and runs offload_deep_review.
assertions: Verifies execution inside a dedicated git worktree (not directly on protected integration branch)
Builds complete manifest across source, tests, configs, and docs/ prior to editing
Executes deterministic sweep under Fast-mechanical (high effort) preserving comments and <400L file ceiling
Verifies zero remaining stale occurrences, runs canonical tests via offload_log_triage, and executes offload_deep_review on the diff
